name: bridge
description: Hedera bridge starter template with Foundry contracts and Axelar ITS, Chainlink CCIP, and LayerZero OFT flows.

steps: This template is an educational bridge starter.
1. Generate or import a deployer account: {run:foundry:account:generate}
2. Configure packages/foundry/.env with ACCOUNT, SEPOLIA_RPC_URL, and HEDERA_TESTNET_RPC_URL.
5. Choose one bridge provider and open its runbook: cd packages/foundry && make axelar-help, make ccip-help, or make layerzero-help.
6. Deploy and configure that provider by following its README from packages/foundry/script/<provider>/README.md.
7. Sync the deployed provider config into the frontend: cd packages/foundry && make bridge-sync-next PROVIDER=<provider>.
9. Connect a funded testnet wallet, select the configured provider, and send a small test transfer. Some Hedera HTS flows require receiver association before receiving.
10. Extend this app with the co-versioned harness recipe: {run:harness:extend}
After this, customize the bridge provider config, contracts, UI, limits, fees, and operational controls to fit your product.
